Inside the free class

Learn the deal.
Build the operation.

Getting a deal is one step. Delivering across several campaigns takes a process. We’ll walk through finding opportunities, producing efficiently, and learning from performance.

01

Understand tech UGC deals.

See how per-video payments and view bonuses work. We’ll explain the $30–$50 video deals in our experience, what varies by campaign, and how to evaluate the terms.

02

Find more deals—and better terms.

Learn how we approach opportunities, position our work, and pursue higher-paying deals. Start with your first campaign or build on the clients you already have.

03

Produce more without doing it all.

Explore our workflow for editors, faster video production, multiple variations, and scheduled posting—so you can keep several campaigns moving at once.

04

Test content. Learn from the results.

Learn how we assess account and video performance, decide what to test next, and track bonus opportunities. Finish with live Q&A and an introduction to our six-month mentorship.
